scope: Read-only cross-review of new credit runtime/evaluation/revisitation/protocol against its local derivative helper and frozen dependencies. Only this evidence JSON is written.

checks.finding: Each Heun stage drops cross-neuron sensitivities. E has direct recurrent sources at both stages; F has a pulse source only after flow. This is a diagonal forward derivative approximation, not exact dense RTRL or an RFLO/e-prop reproduction. Dense-reference error is explicitly measured in research-forward.json.

Unnormalized weighted CE residuals/head gradients and target-weight mass accumulate over the source chunk. Division occurs once per source. The head gradient is analytic and exact for that source state; core gradients are approximate.

BP keeps the live chunk graph and detaches live h only after extracting its gradients. Manual modes use no reverse graph. Parameters remain unchanged during all source forward passes. Hidden values are continuous; a 64-tick update does not clear h.

BP old graph covers all128 ticks, with loss only on the final64. Diagonal old E/F start zero and evolve through all128, using no warm-up labels. Saved historical h is constant. Neither branch reconstructs a true derivative before the saved boundary. This BP old horizon differs from the prior frozen replay64 experiment.

Current/old source losses are normalized independently, gradients average0.5/0.5 under the same pre-update weights, then one global clip and one inherited Adam step. This equals differentiating that fixed-source average objective for BP; it is not two sequential optimizer steps.

Nested model, Adam, live hidden, world/receipts/contracts/clocks/scheduler, RNGs, replay bank, tick/update/hash/statistics state continue. Credit adds both E/F collectors, feedback and private RNGs, sampler RNG, work/gain counters and regime history. Old state never overwrites live h; named reset controls affect only E/F.

Live and replay use identical initial fixed B and saved initial row scales. Shuffle uses its own saved RNG; old sampling is independent. No adaptive B rescaling or use of evaluation labels is introduced.

Core gradients are None in readout-only, so inherited core Adam moments cannot drift the frozen encoder/recurrence. The head still inherits its optimizer state. This is a pretrained nonspiking reservoir control, not a random LSM replication.

Credit run/local snapshots and hashes plus frozen integration restoration dependency accompany checkpoints; strict resume checks current and saved core sources. Prepare_study binds all credit/continuity/integration source hashes and origin checkpoint bytes in command manifests.

Evaluation clones complete model/world/h, preserves process RNG/settings, checks full continuation and checkpoint bytes unchanged, and pairs interventions on external events/scheduler/cohort fingerprints. Baseline action_policy=model; oracle branches are diagnostic counterfactuals, not autonomous model scores. Matched cue-to-first-legal loss excludes no-legal cases; those counts must remain separate.

A/B changes affect future contracts only at complete optimizer boundaries. Milestones save full continuation and evaluate cloned states without altering training. Completed milestone resume validates origin/protocol/last checkpoint hashes. Familiar-regime reacquisition is not a new-task plasticity proof.

interpretation_limits: Forward-only describes new-phase gradient computation. Model features and inherited Adam moments were produced by earlier supervised BPTT; no end-to-end BP-free origin or biological locality claim follows.

Replaying real old observations/labels also changes the objective, supervised work and historical BP horizon. A replay advantage does not isolate old-content exposure alone or establish semantic fusion.

Persistent E/F have no hard chunk reset except named controls, but diagonal gains can attenuate old influence rapidly. Gain summaries omit cross-neuron paths and sources; they are not the whole-network memory or a real gradient horizon.
Live E/F become stale after parameter updates. Exact numerical save/resume is distinct from exact historical sensitivities with respect to current weights.
diag_instant still includes sensitivity over the current observation flow and reads a history-dependent h. It is an eligibility-history reset control, not a memoryless network.

diag_shuffle leaves the exact head gradient, inherited Adam moments and shared signal components intact. Its result tests signal pairing under this transformation; it is not no-learning or a proof that all core task signal was removed.
Joint clipping couples head/core gradient scales. Identical analytic head formulas do not imply identical head optimizer updates across arms.
The generic report continuity sentence must be interpreted with mode.reset and actual reset counters: diag_reset64/diag_instant intentionally reset only E/F. No live h/world reset occurs.
CPU and CUDA may differ numerically. Same-device BP-control regression establishes implementation equivalence, not bitwise reproduction of an earlier CUDA score after choosing CPU for the new study.

First-legal/age-bin readouts are conditional on the cohort actually reaching that opportunity; no-legal and no-cue requests remain separate and must not be counted as forgetting. Oracle rescue remains diagnostic only.
